scripts.build:base-app: cd ./projects/base-app && ng build && cd ../../dist/base-app && npm pack
scripts.build:asset-roster: cd ./projects/asset-roster && ng build && cd ../../dist/asset-roster && npm pack
scripts.build:calendar: cd ./projects/calendar && ng build && cd ../../dist/calendar && npm pack
scripts.build:crm: cd ./projects/crm && ng build && cd ../../dist/crm && npm pack
scripts.build:all: npm run build:base-app && npm run build:asset-roster && npm run build:calendar && npm run build:crm
scripts.generate:base-app-graph: npx depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js projects/base-app --output-type dot | dot -Tsvg -o base-app-graph.svg
scripts.generate:asset-roster-graph: npx depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js projects/asset-roster --output-type dot | dot -Tsvg -o asset-roster-graph.svg
scripts.generate:calendar-graph: npx depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js projects/calendar --output-type dot | dot -Tsvg -o calendar-graph.svg
scripts.generate:crm-graph: npx depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js projects/crm --output-type dot | dot -Tsvg -o crm-graph.svg
scripts.generate:all-graphs: npm run generate:base-app-graph && npm run generate:asset-roster-graph && npm run generate:calendar-graph && npm run generate:crm-graph
